content: Smart Pathogen Control The Rising Need for Sustainable Mold Management in Modern Feed Systems Current feed systems struggle with moisture, long storage, and inconsistent ingredient quality, which foster bacterial and fungal growth. These pathogens produce mycotoxins, harmful metabolites that ruin feed quality and threaten animal health. As the industry shifts toward antibiotic-free and residue-free standards, there is an urgent need for natural, sustainable ways to manage these risks and ensure safe nutrition. Challenges Inconsistent mold control, especially against resistant fungal strains Incomplete suppression of mold growth, allowing recurrence over time Risk of nutrient degradation and reduced feed palatability Limited effectiveness against toxin-producing molds Rising concerns over chemical residues, safety, and sustainability. Ineffective elimination of bacteria like Salmonella and E. coli, raising transmission risks. Growing AMR, making surviving bacteria increasingly difficult to treat. SynDmold™ is an advanced solution for feed hygiene management, comprising of bio available Phyto actives synergised TM with minerals through complexation. SynDMold This synergistic formulation delivers broad-spectrum activity against mold and bacteria. It ensures feed sanitization, and nutrient protection—naturally and effectively. ACTIVITY AGAINST PATHOGENS Pathogen SynDmold S. typhi 23 E. coli 29 P. aeruginosa 24 C Sporogens 23 A. Niger 30 C. albicans 23 Mode of Action Cell Membrane Disruption – Plant actives destabilize fungal cell walls, leading to leakage and cell death. Metabolic Interference – Inhibits key enzymatic pathways required for mold growth & replication. Oxidative Stress Modulation – Polyphenols induce oxidative imbalance within fungal cells. Mineral-Stabilised Action – Mineral complexation enhances persistence & uniform activity across feed matrices.
